title: Add 'Locations' feature
body: Locations — add and remove locations via search by city, country or time zone abbreviation (EST, IST). Each location is stored by its IANA identifier ("Europe/Moscow"), never by a raw UTC offset.

decisions.body: Fix the judge's last finding: fallback: "none" for Intl.DisplayNames is  repeated in packages/client/src/adapters/city-search/zoneCitiesSource.ts:92 and packages/client/src/presenter/countryName.ts:11. Add REGION_DISPLAY_FALLBACK = "none" to constants/search.ts, export it via constants/index.ts, use it in both files.
decisions.author: tracker
